purpose: Qualify the missing identity and corporate-action dependencies for retrospective T-only 120-session Facts windows; no result-bearing training.

proposed_scope.dimension_use: Versioned security/listing identity and validity fields for admitted historical sessions only. Exclude later-only listings and attributes; current identity or current membership is never a historical proxy.
proposed_scope.corporate_action_use: Use only the two checksum-bound accepted v3 replay members. Preserve normalization/authority/exception lineage. Do not regenerate normalized actions from raw parent or term tables.
proposed_scope.physical_access_boundary: Verify complete immutable file bytes and metadata, then use a fixed date/identity guard before materializing any payload rows. No protected-year market/result rows may be returned, serialized, counted as development supply or consumed by Facts. This is explicitly a bounded projection from mixed-year source members, not whole-member market authority.
proposed_scope.action_row_guard: 2012-01-01 <= effective_date <= T <= 2021-12-31, plus historical SSE/SZSE identity; keep known_at and retrospective/as-known distinction.
proposed_scope.exception_guard: Retain only blocking-control intervals intersecting 2012-2021: blocked_from <= 2021-12-31 AND (blocked_through IS NULL OR blocked_through >= 2012-01-01). A pre-2012 blocked_from is control provenance for the admitted period, not authorization for 2011 market features; preserve the original interval and distinguish known_at from effective date.

execution_sequence_after_separate_activa: Freeze complete selected member inventory, schema, source/config/code digests, historical projection and resource budget before payload access.

Verify exact member checksums; project historical identity, admitted normalized actions and intersecting exception controls once into job-local TMP. Record rejected or ambiguous identities separately without exporting excluded rows.

Before claiming left-boundary completeness, obtain the original normalization manifest at its bound SHA; verify kind, revision, ready_for_snapshot=true, execution_authorized=false, scope.start=2012-01-01, scope.end>=2021-12-31, both checksums, policy, exception-ledger and lineage digests. Its absence does not prevent identity-only inspection, but blocks coordinate/window qualification. Do not read upstream reports or market payloads to replace this metadata.

For every T, use the accepted serialization/order over the full source-scope action prefix through T, never only the last 120 sessions. Unknown prehistory stays unavailable; a later new action does not repair an unknown prefix. Empty means none within the verified version scope, not none in all history.

Only after that equivalence and source-availability gate passes, freeze a bounded Facts materialization using the existing accepted engine and exact code/config. Reuse each prerequisite once per Job; formal independent rebuild remains separate.
Derive ordinary ACTIVE/X through the governed inference controls and record all unavailable reasons. Tradability, a source epoch string or a successful join cannot stand in for ACTIVE.
Seal readiness denominators and reference/exposure qualifications independently. Same-origin old rule references never become independent truth. B stays unaccepted until its full contract passes.
missing_evidence_disposition: Keep unknown counts null and stop the affected materialization stage with an explicit reason; do not shrink windows, infer identities, import unbound corrections or weaken reference gates.
unknown_scope_row_disposition: Null or invalid dates/identities cannot be silently treated as out of scope. Stop the affected member qualification without exporting the raw ambiguous row.
exception_control_grade: Retrospective fail-closed control. Inclusive blocked_from/blocked_through, open-ended intervals remain blocked until the accepted ledger resolves them; a later normal action does not clear them. This does not establish historical as-known ACTIVE.
